name: IVADO Postdoctoral Research Funding Program 2027
funder: IVADO (Institut de valorisation des données), Québec
eligibility: PhD earned < 3 years before funding start; supervisor = regular faculty at UdeM, Polytechnique, HEC Montréal, Laval or McGill (IVADO-affiliated); full-time research in Québec
eligibility_note: Open to national and international researchers; no citizenship requirement; ODA-country applicants may claim relocation costs.
deadline_quote: Application deadline: 11:59 PM Eastern Time on November 22, 2026
how_to_apply_tip: Secure a supervisor at one of the 5 partner universities now (each supervisor can back only ONE application) and make sure reference letters arrive by the same 22 Nov deadline.
verdict_reason: Your PhD (after Nov 2024) is well within the <3-year window, the call is open to international applicants and sets no age, gender or institution-type bar. You would need leave from (or to leave) BIC, because the award funds full-time research and you must live in Québec.
eligibility_quote: "Have earned their doctorate less than three years prior to the beginning of the IVADO funding"; "Applications from candidates whose primary doctoral affiliation is outside Quebec are strongly encouraged."; "The postdoctoral researcher must remain in Quebec for the entire duration of the funding period."; "The funding is provided solely for full-time research activity."

name: Vector Distinguished Postdoctoral Fellowship

eligibility_note: Official page states no nationality or PhD-window rule (job-board copies mention PhD within 3 years, not confirmed on Vector's page).
deadline_quote: Spring Cohort: Applications due February 28, 23:59 EST (page lists recurring cohort dates without a year; Autumn Cohort: August 31, 23:59 EST)
how_to_apply_tip: Single PDF: cover letter, CV, publications, research statement + 3 reference letters; name 1-2 Vector faculty you want to work with.
verdict_reason: Nothing on the official page excludes you, but it publishes no PhD-window, nationality or current-employment rule, and the spring deadline is shown without a year.
eligibility_quote: Page describes the ideal candidate as "an early career researcher with the potential to become a world-class machine learning scientist"; applications "reviewed on a rolling basis twice per year".
ask_funder: I am a Pakistani national with an EE PhD (awarded <2 years ago), currently an Associate Professor at a private college in Pakistan. Am I eligible for the Spring 2027 cohort (deadline 28 Feb 2027), and is there a maximum time since PhD?

name: FAPESP Post-Doctoral Fellowship (PD)
amount: Monthly stipend per FAPESP table (fapesp.br/3162) + research overhead + moving allowance
duration: Up to 36 months (renewable to 48 in some grant-linked cases)
eligibility: Doctorate < 7 years; supervisor employed at a São Paulo-state research institution submits via SAGe; exclusive dedication
eligibility_note: Open worldwide; foreign candidates must arrange their own Brazilian visa/residence.
deadline_quote: "Applications may be submitted to FAPESP at any time throughout the year."
how_to_apply_tip: Find a São Paulo supervisor (USP, UNICAMP, UNESP, ITA) with an active FAPESP grant; they submit for you. Also watch fapesp.br/oportunidades for pre-funded PD openings in AI/robotics.
verdict_reason: Your PhD date and nationality fit, but the fellowship requires exclusive dedication and bars formal employment; holding your BIC Associate Professor post would only be possible if FAPESP accepts a leave of absence.
eligibility_quote: "Candidates for the Post-Doctoral Fellowship must have completed their Doctorate less than 7 (seven) years ago"; "The Fellowship requires exclusive dedication to the research project."; "Throughout the term of their Fellowship, Fellowship Recipients are not allowed to be formal employees"; "At the discretion of FAPESP, situations may be considered in which the candidate is a formal employee and has a leave of absence from the affiliated institution, with or without salary, that allows for exclusive dedication to research."
ask_funder: Would FAPESP accept a PD fellow who holds a permanent Associate Professor post at a private college in Pakistan and takes unpaid leave for the fellowship period?

name: Mitacs Elevate Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: CAD 60,000/yr (min. CAD 55,000 stipend + up to 5,000 research); partner contributes CAD 30,000/yr
eligibility: PhD within last 5 years; postdoc status at a Canadian university for whole term; academic supervisor at Canadian institution; non-academic partner organisation
eligibility_note: Official page accepts PhD graduates from international institutions; no citizenship bar stated (work permit needed).
deadline_quote: "Elevate proposals are now accepted all year round."
how_to_apply_tip: You need both a Canadian professor willing to host you as a postdoc AND an industry/non-profit partner paying CAD 30k/yr; robotics companies are natural partners.
verdict_reason: Your PhD (<5 yrs) and foreign PhD are accepted, but you must hold postdoc status at a Canadian university during the award, which you do not yet have; the page is silent on applicants holding a permanent faculty post elsewhere.
eligibility_quote: "applicants should have completed their PhD within the last five years."; "We accept PhD graduates from international academic institutions for this program."
ask_funder: Can a Pakistani national who is currently an Associate Professor in Pakistan apply for Elevate if a Canadian university will appoint him as a postdoc for the fellowship term (on leave from the home post)?

name: Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) – Postdoctoral component (V2)
funder: Fonds de recherche du Québec (FRQ) / Québec Ministry of Higher Education
eligibility: Non-Canadian; PhD ≤ 2 years before competition closing; must be PRESELECTED by a Québec university or CCTT network; postdoc at an institution other than PhD-granting one
eligibility_note: V2 component open to candidates from all countries who are not Canadian citizens/PRs.
deadline_quote: 2027-2028 preselection instructions: "Les responsables doivent sauvegarder, valider et transmettre le formulaire au plus tard le 27 octobre 2026 à 16 h (heure du Québec)." (candidate-stage date for 2027-28 not published on FRQ site; 2026-27 candidate deadline was "December 2nd, 2025 at 16:00 (EST)")
how_to_apply_tip: You cannot apply directly: a Québec university's PBEEE liaison must preselect you (2027-28 preselection closed 27 Oct 2026). Contact a host's PBEEE office early in the next cycle (usually summer).
verdict_reason: Nationality and PhD rules fit you now, but the 2027-28 university preselection already closed (27 Oct 2026) and the next cycle's 2-year PhD window may exclude you depending on your exact PhD date.
eligibility_quote: "Ce concours est ouvert à toutes les personnes candidates qui ne détiennent pas la citoyenneté canadienne ou le statut de résident permanent du Canada"; "Les bourses de recherche postdoctorale s'adressent aux chercheuses et chercheurs en formation qui ont obtenu leur doctorat depuis deux ans ou moins à la date de fermeture du concours"; "Seuls les candidats présélectionnés par un établissement universitaire québécois ou le Réseau CCTT peuvent soumettre une candidature."

eligibility_quote: "Forrest Fellowships are open to both domestic and international applicants, from any country."; "To be eligible to apply applicants must be in their final year of PhD or no more than two years post PhD conferral."

name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA) – successor to Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
eligibility: PhD ≤ 3 years before 1 Sep of application year; foreign nationals only if doing/completed PhD or postdoc at a Canadian institution; must not hold or be on leave from tenure-track/tenured faculty post
eligibility_note: Foreign nationals eligible only with a Canadian doctoral or postdoctoral connection; Banting itself no longer accepts applications.

eligibility_quote: Foreign nationals may apply only if "currently in a Canadian doctoral or health professional program, have completed one at a Canadian institution, or are doing postdoctoral research at a Canadian institution"; applicants must "not hold or be on leave from a tenure-track or tenured faculty position."
